einzeiler: Spike Einbinder and Honey Pluton discuss pop culture, nostalgia, and personal formation.
kurzfassung: The hosts are joined by guests Spike Einbinder and Honey Pluton to mourn legendary figures and discuss formative cultural touchstones. The conversation ranges from Jackass and David Lynch to SpongeBob SquarePants and childhood memories. Throughout the episode, the group blends humor, personal anecdotes, and heartfelt reflections on media that shaped them.
stichpunkte: The hosts open the episode by lightheartedly mourning the hypothetical passing of iconic figures like Dolly Parton and Tim Curry.
Guests Spike Einbinder and Honey Pluton join the show to share their astrological pop culture breakdowns, featuring Jackass and David Lynch.
The group explores the homoeroticism and enduring cultural legacy of the stunt franchise Jackass.
Spike recounts sneaking out through the dog door at age fourteen to watch midnight screenings of The Rocky Horror Picture Show.
Honey Pluton explains why SpongeBob SquarePants served as an unconventional chosen family and artistic touchstone.
The conversation touches on the therapeutic power of crying, praying, and maintaining phone communication in a digital world.
The episode concludes with the signature 'I Don't Think So Honey' segments, tackling pizza delivery slices, coffee shop seating, and blind dogs.

beschreibung:
Spike Einbinder and Honey Pluton bend the culture medium with their astrological sun, moon, and rising culture breakdown with Matt + Bo on Las Cultch! But first, the episode must mourn, but mourning is celebrating bodymaxxx full body chills for the legendary icon Dolly Parton and the ever important Tim Curry. Spike and Honey shed light on living in NY but BEING an Angeleno, how angel numbers follow you, cheese pulls on Instagram are actually more explicit than nudity on the platform and how watching Dancing with the Stars is like watching Ben-Hur and can be characterized as “tantric Television.” Also the impact of the Instagram presence of Vin Diesel, cultural excavation of Jackass as many things, including an enduring and beautiful display of the masculine fascination with the butthole and what it can handle, Spongebob Squarepants as a queer Simpsons, the repression of Squidward and how every frame of the series is a meme, and the equal talent and desperation of Kathy Griffin and seeking validation from the institutions you wish to destroy.
IDTSH's on: pizza places that don't deliver slices, coffee shops don't have seats anymore, not believing in God, and pitying Spike's blind dog named Spider-man
See these two on tour! And remember: Dolly would want us to pray!
